_about: The Act Four v5 port's plan for pixel/tools/lock.py (the pipeline's test: the v5 act re-locked and re-rendered through the episode pipeline must match lock_v5.py's data-v5.ts and render5's frames). The Act Four specifics lock_v5.py hard-codes are written here as data: the episode timecode, the stick mix's 72-frame title card, D6 and the four sound marks. The timeline is the one data-v5.ts was cut from (git 2fd8da5, before the 2026-09-27 hedge-label removal), read from git by lock.py (`timeline`: git:<rev>:<path>).
